summary: Needs fix. The active launcher now enters runDecomposition and removes the direct job-to-agent path, but it still permits an environment-forgeable test-mode mock bypass, does not bind the router-selected model to the Pi invocation, blocks the configured fallback before routing, and records mismatched launcher provenance.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: The harness is physically separate from packages/worker-harness and never loads craft-pool.
evidence: packages/orchestrator-harness/package.json exposes only its local agents and skills.
test/work-intake/decomposition-architecture-boundaries.test.ts checks separation and absence of worker-harness/craft-pool references.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Its decomposer emits only id, intent, change_spec, acceptance_criteria, and depends_on for each node.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts validates the exact five node fields and rejects unknown top-level or node fields.
packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/launch.mjs now routes through scripts/run-decomposition.mjs rather than passing the job directly to Pi.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Kimi K3 is the bootstrap decomposition model with only approved fail-closed fallback policy.
evidence: packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/pi-model-invoker.mjs accepts invocation.model but does not pass it to Pi; its argument list has no selected-model option.

packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/preflight.mjs rejects launch when either configured model is unavailable, so an unavailable Kimi K3 prevents the approved Sol fallback from reaching model routing.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: The invocation records prompt, model, tool, package, and code-graph revision provenance.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts records sanitized prompts, selectedModel, routing, breadth, package, and IndexRevision.

Its launcherIdentity() records packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/launch.mjs as launcher.path while recording runtime-versions.json's Pi-binary digest, so the recorded path and digest do not identify the same executable.
Because pi-model-invoker.mjs does not forward invocation.model, selectedModel provenance can differ from the model actually invoked.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Schema-invalid output is rejected or repaired only within an explicit bounded policy; the model cannot validate, persist, approve, or dispatch its own DAG.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts enforces response and node limits, one repair maximum, and an invocation-wide deadline.
packages/orchestrator-harness/agents/spec-decomposer.md exposes only the read tool and prohibits validation, persistence, approval, and dispatch.

risks: High: AGENT_POOL_TEST_MODE is an environment variable, not a production security boundary; a launcher caller can set it together with AGENT_POOL_MOCK_* values and receive mock availability, breadth, or model output.
High: the selected routing model is not included in the actual Pi invocation, making effective model choice and model provenance unreliable.
Medium: AGENT_POOL_WORKSPACE remains caller-selected, so derived HOME/XDG roots are not under a verified launcher-owned parent and can be raced or redirected through attacker-controlled ancestors.
Medium: the runtime fixture digest is a fake-launcher test value and no real Pi effective-tool/model attestation is recorded.
recommended_next_step: Return to F. Remove mocks from the production launcher path (use test-only dependency injection instead); pass and assert the selected provider-qualified model in Pi's effective invocation; let verified live availability reach selectForRole so only the approved fallback is selected; derive fresh roots beneath a canonical launcher-owned private parent; and record/reverify the actual Pi executable path and digest immediately before spawn.

attempted: Reviewed original and revised C artifacts, passed plan-security report, persisted F artifact, latest follow-up F artifact, current launcher, preflight, adapter, deterministic harness, configuration, and tests.
Mapped every revised C trust boundary to current evidence or a finding.
failure_context.failure_reason: The active launcher still has production-reachable mock controls and does not enforce the selected model at the Pi boundary.
discoveries: The direct AGENT_POOL_JOB_PATH-to-spec-decomposer launch was removed; launch.mjs runs preflight then run-decomposition.mjs.
HOME/XDG override and pre-existing derived-root rejection are implemented, and AGENT_POOL_SKIP_EXTERNAL_CHECKS is rejected.
Sanitization, bounded limits, validation, repair, deadline, and deterministic provenance execute through runDecomposition.
dead_ends: This read-only environment has no command-execution tool; prior F test attestations were reviewed but not rerun.

trust_boundaries_reviewed: Untrusted decomposition jobs: covered by validateJob, size limits, revision binding, sanitization, and active launch routing through runDecomposition.

Target graph context: covered by bounded breadth retrieval, revision matching, prompt sanitization, and graph-size checks; mock breadth remains production-reachable through the test-mode bypass finding.

Availability and bootstrap routing: finding. AGENT_POOL_SKIP_EXTERNAL_CHECKS is rejected, but test-mode mock availability is accepted and preflight rejects an otherwise valid approved fallback scenario before routing.

Wrapper-to-Pi launcher boundary: finding. Absolute non-symlink launcher/version/digest checks and isolated roots run, but AGENT_POOL_WORKSPACE is caller-selected and the actual Pi call is not bound to the selected model.
Pi/model provider boundary: finding. Sanitized prompts, response limits, deadline, and repair bounds are active, but AGENT_POOL_TEST_MODE plus AGENT_POOL_MOCK_MODEL_RESPONSES bypasses the Pi call.
Invalid output and repair: covered by deterministic strict validation, capped diagnostics, response/node limits, one repair maximum, and remaining-deadline enforcement.
Orchestrator versus worker capability boundary: covered by package separation, explicit package settings, architecture tests, and read-only agent frontmatter.

Invocation provenance: finding. Sanitized prompt, routing, breadth, package, and IndexRevision are recorded, but launcher path/digest identify different files and selectedModel is not bound to the Pi invocation.
Candidate handoff: covered by deterministic output projection; no persistence, approval, queue, Gate 1, or dispatch interface is exposed.

security_findings.message: Environment-controlled test mode enables a mock production bypass.
evidence: packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/launch.mjs:83-100 accepts AGENT_POOL_TEST_MODE=1 and copies every AGENT_POOL_MOCK_* value into the child environment.
packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/run-decomposition.mjs:71-89 consumes mocked availability and breadth results.
packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/pi-model-invoker.mjs:46-57 returns AGENT_POOL_MOCK_MODEL_RESPONSES without spawning Pi.
An invoker can set these variables before launch; the flag has no trusted issuer or deployment-only enforcement.

security_findings.message: The router-selected model is not enforced at the Pi invocation boundary.
evidence: packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/pi-model-invoker.mjs receives invocation.model but constructs Pi arguments without that model.
The effective agent settings retain Kimi K3 as the agent override, so a router decision for Sol is neither passed nor proven effective.
packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/preflight.mjs rejects any missing allowed model before runDecomposition, preventing the approved fallback path from operating on the active launcher.

security_findings.message: Derived configuration roots are still based on a caller-selected workspace and provenance mismatches launcher path to digest.
evidence: packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/launch.mjs derives roots from AGENT_POOL_WORKSPACE without canonical launcher-owned workspace verification.
src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts launcherIdentity() reports launch.mjs as path and runtime-versions.json's Pi launcher digest as digest.

security_commands: Reviewed follow-up F attestation reporting npm test --prefix packages/orchestrator-harness, npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run test:worker passed; not rerun in this read-only session.
residual_risk: Blocker: mock inputs can bypass live provider invocation on the active launcher.
Blocker: actual Pi model selection and its provenance are not reliably bound to routing.
After fixes, retain residual risk that deterministic secret recognition is incomplete and provider cancellation can lag local timeout.
